source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, cover page
source.quote: The number of shares outstanding of the registrant's common stock was 1,070 million at November 2, 2026.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as QCOM. The FY2026 10-K cover (filed November 4, 2026) is the latest count and is newer than the June 2026 10-Q; Qualcomm states it rounded to the nearest million (1,070 million).
